definitions.explanation: Refers to a portion of a larger whole.

definitions.gloss: one copy (of a book, document, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Used as a counter for copies of publications or documents.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}の{一部|いちぶ}は{反対|はんたい}した。
{計画|けいかく}の{一部|いちぶ}を{変更|へんこう}する。
examples.english: We'll change part of the plan.

examples.japanese: これは{問題|もんだい}の{一部|いちぶ}にすぎない。
examples.english: This is only part of the problem.

examples.japanese: {資料|しりょう}を{一部|いちぶ}ずつ{配|くば}ってください。
examples.english: Please distribute one copy of the materials to each person.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{三部|さんぶ}コピーしてください。
examples.english: Please make three copies of the report.

examples.japanese: {申請書|しんせいしょ}は{二部|にぶ}{提出|ていしゅつ}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to submit two copies of the application form.

notes:
{一部|いちぶ} has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 — PART/PORTION:
Refers to a portion of a larger whole. Often translates as "some" or "part of."
- {一部|いちぶ}の{人|ひと}: some people
- {一部|いちぶ}を{除|のぞ}いて: except for a part
- ～の{一部|いちぶ}として: as part of ~
- {一部|いちぶ}{始終|しじゅう}: the whole story, full details

SENSE 2 — ONE COPY:
A counter for copies of documents, books, or publications.
- {一部|いちぶ}: one copy
- {二部|にぶ}: two copies
- {三部|さんぶ}: three copies

CONTRAST:
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: all, everything (opposite of sense 1)
- {大部分|だいぶぶん}: most, the greater part
- {一部分|いちぶぶん}: a portion (more explicit than {一部|いちぶ})
